items.question: What kind of advertising experience does Pedro have?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“What kind of advertising experience does Pedro have?”，自然应答是“He used to make television commercials.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（He used to make television commercials.）。
